title: Python: Lists
description: Write a Python program that demonstrates list creation, indexing, slicing, and common operations.

codeTemplate.py:
nums = [10, 20, 30, 40, 50]
print(f"List: {nums}")
print(f"First: {nums[0]}, Last: {nums[-1]}")
print(f"Slice [1:4]: {nums[1:4]}")
nums.append(60)
print(f"After append: {nums}")
print(f"Length: {len(nums)}")
print(f"Sum: {sum(nums)}")

verificationTest: output.includes('List: [10, 20, 30, 40, 50]') && output.includes('First: 10, Last: 50') && output.includes('Slice [1:4]: [20, 30, 40]') && output.includes('After append: [10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60]') && output.includes('Sum: 210')
hints: Lists are mutable sequences created with square brackets `[]`
Negative indices count from the end: `-1` is the last element
`append()` adds an element to the end of a list
